preventable: MATERIAL_RECEIVED_AFTER_DISQUALIFICATION: material lot MLOT-2606-0055 was received after SUP-04 was disqualified on 2026-05-20 (see mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2606-0055). SOP-SCM-004 §6.2 Immediate actions (effective 2023-04-01) states: "On the effective date, and before the assessment in section 7 begins: - All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine, physically and in the inventory system, irrespective of its own test results and irrespective of any prior release decision recorded against it. ... - Goods receipt is blocked against the supplier. Material received from a supplier on or after their disqualification date should not have been accepted; where such a receipt has occurred it is quarantined on discovery and a deviation is raised under SOP-QA-007 against the receipt itself, separately from any deviation raised against the material." (sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#6. Disqualification > 6.2 Immediate actions)

MATERIAL_IN_STOCK_NOT_QUARANTINED: the assessment reports multiple material lots from SUP-04 present in stock and not quarantined (see notQuarantined list including MLOT-2402-0097, MLOT-2405-0047, MLOT-2405-0039, MLOT-2406-0002, MLOT-2407-0048, MLOT-2501-0106, MLOT-2501-0053, MLOT-2503-0042, MLOT-2505-0092, MLOT-2506-0100, MLOT-2506-0044, MLOT-2506-0108, MLOT-2603-0070, MLOT-2606-0055). SOP-SCM-004 §6.2 Immediate actions (effective 2023-04-01) states: "All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine, physically and in the inventory system, irrespective of its own test results and irrespective of any prior release decision recorded against it. ... The quarantine in this section is preventive and is not a finding about the material. It is applied first because it is the only action in this procedure that becomes impossible once the material is consumed." (sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#6. Disqualification > 6.2 Immediate actions)

escalate.reason: Material received after disqualification or in-stock material not quarantined requires an immediate preventive decision under SOP-SCM-004 §6.2.

SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 §6.2 Immediate actions (quoted): "On the effective date, and before the assessment in section 7 begins:

- **All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine**, physically
  and in the inventory system, irrespective of its own test results and
  irrespective of any prior release decision recorded against it. A material lot
  that has passed its own incoming testing is not thereby exempt: the basis of
  the disqualification is the supplier, not the consignment.
- **Goods receipt is blocked** against the supplier. Material received from a
  supplier on or after their disqualification date should not have been
  accepted; where such a receipt has occurred it is quarantined on discovery and
  a deviation is raised under SOP-QA-007 against the receipt itself, separately
  from any deviation raised against the material.
- **Open production orders** drawing on that supplier's material are suspended
  pending the assessment.

The quarantine in this section is preventive and is not a finding about the
material. It is applied first because it is the only action in this procedure
that becomes impossible once the material is consumed."

escalate.reason: Material received after disqualification and material in stock not quarantined are present; a human must decide immediate preventive actions (quarantine enforcement, deviations, and goods-receipt blocking).
